book.name: Joŋ
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Joŋ gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Bo gooŋ gvunɛ chi Jiso sɛŋ
Gɛ̀ bee juu chi fwe yi kimaa le, Mɛɛle Madaleŋ bu wu ja lo kibilebile, wu gɛɛŋ fɛ jɛŋ, wu yɛŋ ba chiaasɛ wa tɛdɛ chì ba gɛ̀ baŋɛ jwe wu jɛŋ yu.
Noo, wu mo wu legɛ wu gɛɛŋ wu yɛŋ Samoŋ Bita le bɛ mwa ŋgoo wu Jiso wumu wɛɛ wu Jiso gɛ̀ koŋe wu, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ, “Ba le ba bvusɛ wa Tada a jɛŋ, bee kee gɛ laa ba gɛle wu faaŋ lɛ.”
Bita bɛ mwa ŋgoo wu Jiso wɛɛ mo bo bu bo gɛɛne fɛ jɛŋ.
Bo gɛ̀ gɛɛne bo lege lo, geenɛ mwa ŋgoo wu Jiso wɛɛ legɛ wu fe Bita wu ya wu fɛsɛ fɛ jɛŋ.
No wu fɛse, wu gvuusɛ wu bijɛ, wu yɛŋ njú yi ba gɛ̀ giŋsɛ Jiso yu yi gime yo. Wu bijɛ noo wu gɛ lee yo gɛ.
Samoŋ Bita bi wu le wu fɛsɛ fo, wu mo wu lee lo wu gɛɛŋ a jɛŋ. No wu lese, wu yɛŋ nyu gɛh njú chiɛɛ le yi gime,
mo finchaŋa fi nju fiɛɛ fì ba gɛ̀ dimɛ kikwɛɛ ki Jiso yu fi gime gɛ bɛ njú yimi chiɛɛ gɛ. Geenɛ ba gɛ̀ kɛbe lɛfilɛfi ba gɛɛ ke kijusɛ le.
Mwa ŋgoo wu Jiso wumu wɛɛ wù gɛ̀ yaŋsɛ wu fɛsɛ fɛ jɛŋ mo wu lee tɛ wu gɛɛŋ a jɛŋ wu yɛŋ fiɛɛ finɛ le wu mo wu bɛɛŋ.
Gɛ̀ bee ba baaŋ a kɛɛ gɛ kinyi ki fiɛɛ fì le a Ŋwa wu Nyo le lɛ Jiso gɛ̀ kɛme ki wu gê wu bu yi kwe le gɛ.
Jiso dunyɛ kikwɛɛ ke Mɛɛle Madaleŋ le
Booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Jiso baa kaasɛ bo kwɛɛ fɛ yeh le.
Geenɛ Mɛɛle shɛɛ wu tu wu lɛme wu beede fɛ jɛŋ. No wu gɛ̀ beede wu ja wu gvuusɛ wu bijɛ a jɛŋ,
wu yɛŋ banchɛndaa ba Nyo le bafɛɛ bo noŋ njú yì baaŋ bo shii fɛ ba gɛ̀ giŋsɛ gvunɛ chi Jiso fo, wumu fɛ kikwɛɛ ki Jiso gɛ̀ gime fo, wumu fɛ bikaa bie gɛ̀ gime fo.
Banchɛndaa ba Nyo baa biih wu le lɛ, “Kwɛse, wo beede la?” Wu chvuu lɛ, “Mbeede nje ba le ba chiaasɛ Tada waŋ ba ja bɛ wu gɛ n'ya kee fɛ ba gɛle wu fo gɛ.”
No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu doo wu kaasɛ ye wu yɛŋ Jiso lɛme. Geenɛ wu gɛ̀ baaŋ kɛɛ gɛ lɛ le Jiso gɛ.
Jiso biih wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Kwɛse, wo beede la? Wo goone nyu yɛɛŋ?”

content: Mɛɛle mo wu kwaji lɛ le muh wu jiiŋe fɛ mwɛ wu kitaŋ kwɛɛ le. Wu mo wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Chii, wo nɛ le wo tuu wu wo ja bɛ wu, wo sɛɛŋ mɛ fɛ wo gɛle wu fo ŋgɛɛŋ njo nja bɛ wu.”
Jiso ja wu bɛɛŋ wu lɛ,
Wu kaasɛ ye wu tɛɛŋ wu a jɛ́ yi Ibulu le lɛ, “Laboni”, fì le lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ.”
Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Keefɛ wo jîji mɛne gɛ, nje mbaaŋ a bɛɛŋ gɛ fɛ Chii le gɛ. Gɛ̂nɛ nyu fɛ booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ le wo sɛ̂ɛŋ bo le lɛ mbɛɛne wa fɛ Chii wu le tɛ Chiji wene, mo fɛ Nyo waŋ wu le tɛ Nyo wene.”

content: Mɛɛle Madaleŋ mo wu gɛɛŋ wu sɛɛŋ booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo le lɛ wu le wu yɛŋ Tada le, wu ka wu sɛɛŋ bo le lɛ wu le wu jɛmɛ mwɛɛ munɛ wu le.
Jiso dunyɛ kikwɛɛ ke booŋ be ba ŋgoo le
Gɛ̀ bee fɛnfu abvubwɛɛ nyume juu chi fwe yi kimaa le, booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Jiso nyume yeh bo faa bimbuŋ, nje bo gɛ̀ faane Bajuu. Jiso ja gɛh wu bunɛ wu lɛɛŋ a bo ntɛnɛɛ, wu yɛsɛ bo le lɛ,
No wu jɛme bo le noo, wu mo wu dunyɛ chiaaŋ ye bɛ chita che bo le. Booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo yu njoŋ baaŋ no bo yɛŋ Tada le.
Jiso ka wu kaasɛ wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Kimbonɛ nyûme fɛ bɛŋ le. No Chii gɛ tuŋ mɛ, le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no nlé ntûne bɛŋ mɛ̂ɛse.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu yɛnɛ bo le wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: Bɛŋ nɛ lɛɛshɛ bimbefɛ bi muh, tu Nyo le wu lɛɛshɛ wa. Bɛŋ faŋ ki bɛŋ lɛ̂ɛshɛ, tu bi lé bi mɛ̂ gɛh noo.”

content: Jiso dunyɛ kikwɛɛ ke Toma le
Sege Jiso gɛ̀ to fɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le, Toma wù gɛ̀ bee ŋgoo yi booŋ ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ le wu ba gɛ̀ tɛŋe jee che chimi lɛ Amaŋ, wù gɛ̀ bee gɛ bɛ bo gɛ.

Kimbɛge ki booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Jiso gɛ̀ jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Bee le be yɛŋ Tada le.” Geenɛ, wu jɛmɛ fie bo le lɛ, “Mɛ nɛ nlé njɛ n'yɛŋ de yi bíɛɛŋ chiɛɛ chiaaŋ ye le sɛŋ, nleesɛ kwaaŋ jwe wu bíɛɛŋ yiyu le sɛŋ, nleesɛ tɛ kibo kaŋ yi chita che le sɛŋ, ŋgɛ mbɛɛŋ gɛ.”
Kimaa kuŋ, booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo ka bo nyu yeh, Toma nyu tɛ bɛ bo, ba nyu ba faa de yi fese yi yeh. Geenɛ, Jiso ja wu bunɛ a bo ntɛnɛɛ, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,
No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu jɛmɛ Toma le lɛ,

content.text: “Lêesɛ kwaaŋ wo yi chiaaŋ yaŋ le, wo yɛ̂ŋ no yi le, wo ka wo lêesɛ tɛ kibo kuŋ yi chita chaŋ le. Keefɛ wo mâŋe gɛ, bɛ̂ɛŋ!”

content: Toma chvuu wu le lɛ, “Tada waŋ, mo Nyo waŋ!”
Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo le wo bɛɛŋ mɛɛse nje wo le wo yɛŋ mɛne? Kinlaŋye kì baaŋ le fɛ bamii ba baaŋ yɛŋ gɛ mɛne gɛ, geenɛ, bo bɛɛŋ.”

content: Fiɛɛ fi shaŋ fi ŋwa wunɛ
Jiso gɛ̀ bee wu ge mwɛɛ wesee mù duunyi bvuŋga bvu Nyo, booŋ be ba ŋgoo yɛŋ, ba baaŋ a saŋ gɛ a ŋwa wunɛ le gɛ.
Geenɛ, munɛ mù ba le ba saŋ, lé ki fi gê lɛ bɛŋ bɛɛŋ lɛ Jiso le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka, lɛ le Mwa Nyo. Nɛ bɛŋ bɛmɛ noo, bɛŋ ge bɛŋ kɛmɛ kinche kì kage gɛ nje jee che.
